# check and test-template-mutations take the directory of the package to
# read, resolved like -C, so they can run from the module root against a
# package whose templates variable the root package does not have.

muxt check ./internal/preview
stdout 'ok: 1 template'

muxt -C internal check ./preview
stdout 'ok: 1 template'

muxt test-template-mutations ./internal/preview --dry-run --seed 1
stdout '1 mutant across 1 template'

muxt test-template-mutations ./internal/preview --seed 1 -- -count=1
stdout '1 mutant, 1 killed, 0 missed, 0 skipped'

! muxt check
stderr 'templates'

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
-- internal/preview/greeting.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- internal/preview/template.go --
package preview

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*.gohtml"))

type Greeting struct{ Name string }

func Render(w io.Writer, g Greeting) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", g)
}
-- internal/preview/template_test.go --
package preview

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRender(t *testing.T) {
	var sb strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&sb, Greeting{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(sb.String(), "Hello, World!") {
		t.Errorf("got %q", sb.String())
	}
}
